title: Turbo Decoder
text: Decode input signal using parallel concatenated decoding scheme, 3 inputs, 1 output, {Decoding algorithm} sets Decoding algorithm True; {Trellis structure} sets the trellis description of constituent convolutional code, {numInputSymbols} sets the number of symbols input to encoder, {numOutputSymbols} sets the number of symbols output from encoder, {numStates} sets the number of states in encoder power, {nextStates} sets the next states matrix, {outputs} sets the outputs matrix, {Source of interleaver indices}, {Interleaver indices}, {Source of input indices}, {Input indices}, {Number of scaling bits}, {Number of decoding iterations} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: IntrInd
ports.summary: Interleaver indices column vector of integers

ports.name: InInd
ports.summary: Input indices column vector of integers

params.name: Trellis structure
params.values: Trellis description of constituent convolutional code poly2trellis(4,[13 15],13) (default) | structure

params.values: Number of symbols input to encoder 2 K

params.name: numOutputSymbols
params.values: Number of symbols output from encoder 2 N

params.name: numStates
params.values: Number of states in encoder power of 2
